def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split on '+' to separate build metadata
        version_part, _, _ = v.partition('+')
        
        # Split on '-' to separate pre-release
        core, _, prerelease = version_part.partition('-')
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = core.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            prerelease_identifiers = prerelease.split('.')
        
        # Convert pre-release identifiers to comparable form
        prerelease_comparable = []
        for identifier in prerelease_identifiers:
            if identifier.isdigit():
                prerelease_comparable.append((0, int(identifier)))
            else:
                prerelease_comparable.append((1, identifier))
        
        # Return tuple for sorting
        # (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, prerelease_comparable)
        # has_prerelease: False (no pre-release) sorts after True (has pre-release)
        return (major, minor, patch, len(prerelease_identifiers) == 0, prerelease_comparable)
    
    # Create list of (original_version, sort_key, original_index)
    indexed_versions = [(v, parse_version(v), i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    
    # Sort by sort key, maintaining input order for equal keys
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]))
    
    # Extract the version strings
    return [v[0] for v in sorted_versions]
